reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring, persisting, and applying model output styles at runtime, with optional rendering and session export features.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中按会话切换并持久化模型输出风格，同时支持自定义样式、渲染器和会话导出。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for switching and persisting per-session model output styles with support for custom styles, renderers, and session export.

capabilities: Switches and persists per-session output style selections
Injects selected style instructions into model system prompts
Loads and hot-reloads user-provided style files
Registers output renderers and exports sessions as Markdown or sanitized HTML
